compatibility: Supplement to the frozen client/server v2 contract; existing credential formats and local SESSION commands remain unchanged.
authentication: Registered connection authenticated to the owning account; selectors never grant authority.

discovery.note: Existing onyx/session-sync capability does not establish full-roster readiness. No new client CAP is required by this candidate.

fields.group: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters; opaque logical-group selector
fields.attachment: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters, or 32 dashes for an unavailable physical identity
fields.node: unsigned 64-bit node identifier rendered in hexadecimal

inventory.privacy: Only the authenticated account is enumerated; no bearer credential, real address, signing key, or other account's inventory is emitted.
inventory.freshness: Unknown or stale origin leases must not be displayed as a confirmed offline/revoked state. Row inventory completeness and node support coverage are separate observations.
inventory.limits: Candidate page generation returns at most 32 rows and spends at most 64 indexed origin/row work units. It can return zero rows with continuation. A cursor advances only after the whole labeled or unlabeled output batch is accepted into transport custody. The cache expires after 120 seconds from page issue; lost-reply replay does not refresh it. Full pagination integration/fault/runtime acceptance is in progress; the legacy local inventory and logical revoke selector have separate resource acceptance.

page_fields.rows: Number of rows in this page, from 0 through 32.
page_fields.complete: 0 when continuation is required; 1 at the end of this bounded indexed scan. This does not establish atomic global freshness, full-roster coverage or revoke completion.
page_fields.cursor: Opaque nonzero 32-hex continuation nonce, or none at completion. Never a bearer credential, group ID, attachment ID or local DROP SID.
page_fields.observed_at: Unix milliseconds for this page observation, retained unchanged when its request is replayed.
page_fields.observations: per-page; lease freshness and support coverage can differ between pages.

inventory.continuation: A plain LIST MESH begins a new enumeration. Continue using exactly cursor=<returned nonce>, on the same authenticated physical connection and nickname. A zero-row incomplete page still requires continuation. Repeating a served continuation replays its canonical page with the current command label. Account inventory structural changes, cache expiry, account/nickname changes, connection replacement or Helix invalidate continuation; STALE_LIST requires a fresh LIST MESH.

selectors.group: First 16 bytes of BLAKE3(onyx-session-public-group-v1 followed by NUL followed by the private 16-byte group token), rendered as lowercase hex.
selectors.mesh_attachment_is_not: The derived SID used by local SESSION DROP; do not interchange these equally sized identifiers.

revocation.scope: All physical attachments of the selected logical group across the validated mesh, including the calling connection if it belongs to that group.
revocation.pending_rule: Never infer completion or rollback from PENDING. Preflight may not have committed any fence; a committed notice establishes durable local denial. Later warnings cannot undo that denial.
revocation.polling: Repeat the same command from another authenticated attachment of this account. Preserve the selector while pending; do not use a nickname or a new logical group as an equivalent target.
revocation.complete_rule: OK requires signed durable-denial receipts for every member of the same validated full roster and activation epoch, after local physical authority is fenced.
revocation.partition_rule: Missing support or receipts cannot become success. Durable terminal denial is retained across replay, reconnect, cold restart, and the current strict Helix boundary.
revocation.membership_retirement_limit: Cold restore currently verifies historical fence signers against the configured full roster. Removing a signer can reject startup; a historical-authority migration is required before retiring that signer. Never delete its denial facts to bypass this check.
revocation.other_groups: Unrelated logical groups and account-authentication credentials remain usable.

credential_separation.SESSION TOKEN: Origin-local logical-session credential; publishing inventory alone does not issue portable authority or make an otherwise ineligible group remotely reclaimable through EXTERNAL.
credential_separation.SESSION MTOKEN response: Separately sealed mesh credential emitted in response to TOKEN when supported; not a new MTOKEN request command.
credential_separation.SESSIONTOKEN and SASL SESSION-TOKEN: Account-authentication credentials; not logical-session selectors or interchangeable resume envelopes.
